name: gg-01-differential-adhesion-sorting
title: Differential-adhesion cell sorting (Fig 12)
question:
Under the Glazier & Graner (1993) Fig-12 sorting energies (J_ll=14, J_dd=2, J_ld=11,
J_lM=J_dM=16, T=10; gamma_ld=+3), does the wrapped Artistoo CPM sort a mixed two-type aggregate —
the cohesive dark type retreating to the interior, engulfed by a light monolayer — so that the
heterotypic boundary fraction falls while cells stay intact?
hypothesis:
The heterotypic boundary fraction decreases monotonically over ~176 MCS as the aggregate sorts,
and mean cell connectedness stays near 1.0 (engulfment, not fragmentation). Robust across seeds.
claim:
pbg-artistoo reproduces Fig-12 sorting: heterotypic fraction falls 0.479 -> 0.379 (-21%, mean of
3 seeds) with connectedness 0.998 — clean differential-adhesion engulfment, no motility.

run_config.runner: demo-style direct Composite execution (Node bridge); trajectories in runs/*.csv

readouts.name: heterotypic_fraction
readouts.description: Fraction of cell-cell boundary between UNLIKE types — the paper's sorting order parameter.

readouts.name: mean_connectedness
readouts.description: Mean per-cell connected fraction; 1.0 = every cell is a single intact blob.

behavior_tests.name: heterotypic-fraction-falls-under-sorting
behavior_tests.description: Heterotypic boundary fraction at 176 MCS is below its early (8 MCS) value in every seed.

behavior_tests.name: cells-stay-intact-during-sorting
behavior_tests.description: Mean connectedness stays >= 0.95 (sorting by engulfment, not fragmentation).

reproducibility_metrics.comparison:
3 seeds (1,2,3), 176 MCS, 110 cells on an 85x85 field. Initial = first snapshot (8 MCS);
final = 176 MCS. Trajectories in runs/glazier_graner_cell_sorting_seed{1,2,3}.csv.

findings.statement:
The wrapped Artistoo CPM reproduces Glazier & Graner Fig-12 sorting: with gamma_ld=+3 the
heterotypic boundary fraction falls 0.479 -> 0.379 (-21%, mean of 3 seeds), the cohesive dark
type engulfed by the light monolayer.

expected.summary: Heterotypic boundary fraction decreases as the aggregate sorts (Fig 12).

findings.statement:
Sorting proceeds by engulfment, not fragmentation: mean cell connectedness stays 0.998, so
cells remain intact single blobs while the interface reorganises.

regression_compatibility.basis:
The glazier_graner_cell_sorting composite builds and runs against the real Artistoo engine
(Node bridge) for all 3 seeds; trajectories are committed (runs/*.csv) and the chart renders.

biological_validation.basis:
Heterotypic fraction falls in every seed (-0.10 +/- 0.03, -21%) with connectedness 0.998 —
the qualitative and directional result of Fig 12, from the paper's own energies, no motility.

explanatory_gain.basis:
Confirms the wrapper drives the real CPM Hamiltonian faithfully; establishes heterotypic
fraction as the working sorting order parameter and connectedness as the integrity control
(which becomes the discriminator in gg-02's high-T arm).

limitations: A screen, not a converged study: 176 MCS, 3 seeds, 110 cells on an 85x85 field, single parameter point (the paper's exact Fig-12 energies).
No comparison to a published trajectory curve (the paper reports mechanism/direction, not a digitised hf(t) for these energies), so the match is directional + magnitude, not curve-fitted.

literature_anchors.expectation: Differential adhesion with gamma_ld>0 drives sorting/engulfment; heterotypic contact is minimised.

followup_proposals.title: Converge the sorted state and add more seeds
followup_proposals.motivation:
176 MCS / 3 seeds shows the direction clearly but not the equilibrium sorted fraction. A longer
run (>=1000 MCS) with more seeds would give a converged endpoint + a tight run-to-run band.
followup_proposals.hypothesized_mechanism:
Extend MCS until hf plateaus; report mean +/- band across >=10 seeds; optionally digitise the
paper's engulfment progression for a curve-level comparison.
